name: physics3d
description: Optional 3D rigid-body physics backed by cannon-es. Exposes a DI-bound Physics3DManager stepped on a fixed timestep: create bodies (sphere/box/plane), apply forces, read interpolated position+quaternion transforms, and subscribe to collisions by body id. Engine types never leak; controllers stay engine-agnostic and the view layer never touches physics. Loaded via the @gamebyte/gamelabsjs/physics3d subpath; cannon-es is an optional peer dependency.
